data.title: Unit 7: Heat, light, and sound
Shadow
data.rubric: Drag the correct option to the missing part of the bridge.

question1.text: If the source of light is at the left of an object, the shadow will appear on the right.

question2.text: The position of a shadow depends on the position of the light source.

question3.text: A glass window is an example of an opaque object.

question4.text: Transparent objects form clear shadows because no light passes through them.

question5.text: A shadow is the absence of light, which is why shadows are always black.
